title: Scholarship student
description: Scholarship and bursary of about £420 a month. Halls paid by the scholarship. No debt, steady habits.

title: Rich student
description: About £2,000 a month from parents. Rents a city flat, many subscriptions, Klarna for clothes.

title: Working student
description: Maintenance loan plus weekly bar shifts with pay that changes. Often in the overdraft.

title: Commuter student
description: Lives with family and takes the train in with a 16-25 Railcard. Grant plus family help. Saving for a deposit.
